tests.name: Disenchant Greater Magic Wand
tests.plan: Buy at 3s or less and disenchant for about 4.4s of mats.
tests.result: Bought wands at 3s, then found they cannot be disenchanted in Forever. Vendored 20 at 2s. TSM only logged 2 of the purchases, so the totals here understate the cost until adjust_bought is filled in.
tests.lesson: Check Icy Veins' Forever database for "Cannot be disenchanted" before buying anything to disenchant.

tests.name: Manual: Heavy Silk Bandage vendor flip
tests.plan: Buy at 22s from the vendor and sell near 66s.
tests.result: Dropped before buying. The real auction house price was 25-28s with 270 listed.
tests.lesson: TSM desktop was syncing the Roleplay PvP auction house. Use Auctionator scans for real prices.

tests.name: Recipe: Smoked Bear Meat vendor flip
tests.plan: Bought 5 at 2.5s from Drac Roughcut (Thelsamar, a Tradesman, not a cooking vendor). Post under the lowest listing, about 18s.
tests.result: As of 2026-11-23: 83 bought for 2.08g, 80 sold for 7.55g after the cut (average 9.4s each), +5.47g so far with about 3 left. 46 sold this week, 21 expired postings. Price recovered: lowest 12.5s with 33 listed (7.4s with 100 listed a week ago).
tests.lesson: Best volume flip so far. Keep restocking 5 at a time while the lowest listing stays above about 6s.

tests.name: Recipe: Loch Frenzy Delight vendor flip
tests.plan: Bought 3 at 4s from Khara Deepwater (Loch Modan 39.4 39.2). Post under the lowest listing.
tests.result: As of 2026-11-23: 24 bought for 96s, 19 sold for 1.96g after the cut (average 10.3s each), +1.0g so far with about 5 left. Last sale 2026-11-19; 21 expired postings in total. Listings went from 36 to 145 this week, lowest 9.4s.
tests.lesson: Paused 2026-11-23: sell the stock on hand, do not restock until listings fall back under about 60.

tests.name: Pets vendor flip
tests.plan: 3 Snowshoe Rabbits bought (TSM logged 20s each, Yarlyn Amberstill, Dun Morogh 63.2 50.2). Orange and Silver Tabby still to buy in Elwynn. Arctic and Brown crates skipped: about 40s on the AH versus 75s for Snowshoe.
tests.result: As of 2026-11-23: Snowshoe 3 bought for 60s, 3 sold for 1.08g (+48s). Orange Tabby 2 bought (1 not logged, added in adjust columns) for 80s, 2 sold for 1.05g (+25s). Bombay 1 bought for 40s, sold for 55s (+15s). Total about +88s on 1.80g. Silver Tabby never bought. Tabbies now 51s with 18 listed each (8s profit); Bombay 89s with 18 listed; Snowshoe 45s with 1 listed.
tests.lesson: Pets sell, but only after several relists and only near 38-55s, not the 65s+ first asked. One of each at a time. Tabby listings tripled this week: skip them until the lowest is back near 60s.

tests.name: Disenchant Hillman's Shoulders
tests.plan: Buy 3 at 8s or less, disenchant, and compare the mats to the 9.5s estimate.
tests.result: On hold 2026-11-23: lowest 14s with 167 listed. Mats at US average prices (Soul Dust 4.2s, Greater Astral Essence 15s, Large Glimmering Shard 43s) are worth about 10.8s after the cut. Greater Astral Essence lists at 27s today, but that is a spike.
tests.lesson: Yields come from the DisenchantBuddy addon and are unconfirmed.

tests.name: Recipe: Longjaw Mud Snapper vendor flip
tests.plan: Bought 3 at 4s from Khara Deepwater. Best demand to competition ratio on the list (about 34 sold a day, 4 listed). Post under the lowest listing, about 12s.
tests.result: All 3 sold within 70 minutes of posting, at 9s 95c (9.46s after the cut). 28.4s back on 12s spent: +16.4s. 2026-11-23: lowest back up to 14.1s with 64 listed, about 9.4s profit each.
tests.lesson: Low price but fast: it sold out in about an hour. Worth restocking 5 at a time while it holds above about 7s.

tests.name: Darkmoon frogs: buy during the Faire, sell after it leaves
tests.plan: Buy 1 Tree Frog Box and 1 Wood Frog Box from Flik at the Darkmoon Faire (1g each). Hold until the Faire leaves, then post near the usual price (Tree about 2g, Wood about 1.1-2g).
tests.result: Both sold. Tree Frog Box sold 2026-11-16 for 1.16g after the cut (+16s). Wood Frog Box sold 2026-11-18 for 3.33g after the cut (+2.33g), after 2 expired postings. +2.48g on 2g spent.
tests.lesson: Wood Frog is the one worth holding: it sold for 3x cost a few days after the Faire left. Buy 2 Wood Frogs next time the Faire is in Elwynn; Tree Frog barely covers the cut.

tests.name: Sniper: Instant Poison under vendor price
tests.plan: Bought Instant Poison listed under its vendor sell price, to sell to a vendor.
tests.result: No vendor would buy it in game, even though Wowhead lists a 5c sell price. Kept for Regis to use instead of crafting poison.
tests.lesson: Before a vendor flip, check the item actually sells to a vendor. Rogue poisons show a vendor price in TSM but vendors refuse them.

tests.name: Ironforge leather patterns vendor flip
tests.plan: Granny Finespindle (Ironforge 39.2, 33.4) sells these with unlimited stock. Buy 2 Skulker's Leather Belt, 1 Stalker's, 1 Warden's, 1 Prowler's (21s each) and 2 Dark Leather Boots (5.3s). Listed at 70-78s (belts); Dark Leather Boots usually about 19-23s. Post 1-2 at a time.
tests.result: Not bought yet. 2026-11-23 prices: Skulker's fell from 1.55g to 37s (6 listed), Stalker's 38s, Warden's 26s, Prowler's 41s (8 listed), Dark Leather Boots 16.5s. Now only Prowler's (+18s) and Dark Leather Boots (+10s) are worth a slot; all sell under 2.5 a day.

tests.name: Darnassus limited-stock patterns
tests.plan: Park an alt in Darnassus. Saenorion: Pattern: Barbaric Bracers 20s (lists 4.9g, US average 4g, 2.5 sold a day). Mythrin'dir: Formula: Enchant Bracer - Deflection 61s (lists 2.3g, US 95s). Elynna: Pattern: Orange Martial Shirt 32s (lists 80s). Ulthir (55.9, 25.2): Recipe: Superior Mana Potion 1.26g (lists 3g, US 1.8g) and, added 2026-11-16, Recipe: Great Rage Potion 20s (stock 2, lists 50s, US 39s, about 6 sold a day). Each vendor stocks 1 at a time; buy what is there, mail to Bank Ey.
tests.result: As of 2026-11-23: Deflection 5 bought for 2.90g, 5 sold for 6.99g (+4.09g), but the lowest fell from 2.15g to 90s. Superior Mana Potion 5 bought for 6.00g, 1 sold for 1.90g, 2 expired, 4 on hand; lowest 1.86g but listings jumped from 7 to 55. Orange Martial Shirt 3 bought for 90s, 2 sold for 1.29g, 1 on hand. Barbaric Bracers and Great Rage Potion never bought. Net so far +38s with about 7g of stock on hand.
tests.lesson: Deflection is the best single flip so far but the market caught up. Do not stack expensive limited-stock recipes: 5 Superior Mana Potions at once flooded our own market.

tests.name: Westfall and Loch Modan cheap recipes
tests.plan: Recipe: Clam Chowder 8s from Kriggon Talsone (Westfall 36.2, 90), lists 20s, US 14s, about 5 sold a day: buy 3. Recipe: Rage Potion 1s from Xandar Goodbeard (Loch Modan 82.4, 63.4, stock 2), lists 5s, about 34 sold a day: buy both when passing.
tests.result: Not bought yet. 2026-11-23: Clam Chowder 24s lowest (27 listed, +15s each), Rage Potion 15.5s lowest (54 listed, US average 8s, so expect +6s to +13s).

tests.name: Cross-faction recipes through the neutral AH
tests.plan: Horde character on the second account buys Horde-vendor recipes, lists them on the neutral AH (Ratchet) while an Alliance character stands by to buy, then Bank Ey posts them on the Alliance AH. First run: 2 Prairie Wolf Pup Carrier, 3 Roasted Kodo Meat, 3 Crispy Lizard Tail, 3 Scorpid Surprise. Price the neutral listings high enough to fund the Horde side. Reverse direction (Alliance-only recipes to the Horde AH) needs Horde AH prices first.
tests.result: Not started. 2026-11-23 Alliance prices: Prairie Wolf Pup 4.5g lowest (6 listed, US average 1.15g). The three cooking recipes list at 1.5-1.8g but sell for 8-12.5s on US average, so those listings are not a real price. Only the wolf pup is worth the effort.

tests.name: Ironforge enchanting formulas vendor flip
tests.plan: Tilli Thistlefuzz (Ironforge 60.8, 44.2, The Great Forge) sells these with unlimited stock. Buy 2 Formula: Minor Wizard Oil (5s; lists 19s, usually 12s, about 5 sold a day), 2 Formula: Enchant 2H Weapon - Lesser Intellect (5s; lists 9s, usually 12-14s, about 8 sold a day) and 1 Formula: Minor Mana Oil (30s; lists 79s with 7 listed, usually 50s, 1.5 sold a day). About 50s total. Jessara Cordell in Stormwind sells the two oils as well.
tests.result: Not bought yet. 2026-11-23: Minor Wizard Oil 9.6s (+4s), 2H Lesser Intellect 89s but only 3 listed and US average 12s (expect +6s), Minor Mana Oil 46s with 37 listed (+13s). Still worth it as a stop-by.

tests.name: Recipe: Elixir of Shadow Power (Stormwind limited stock)
tests.plan: Maria Lumere (Stormwind 55.7, 85.5, Mage Quarter) stocks 1 at about 1g. Lists 1.5g with 6 listed, usually 1.2-1.3g, about 3 sold a day. Buy 1 when it is in stock and post just under the lowest listing; skip if the lowest listing is under 1.25g.
tests.result: Not bought yet. 2026-11-23: lowest 1.31g with 16 listed, about +30s. Just above the 1.25g skip line.

tests.name: Recipe: Fillet of Frenzy from Darkshore
tests.plan: Laird (Darkshore 36.8, 44.3, Auberdine dock) sells it for 4.2s, unlimited. Only 3 listed (50s asked), usual price about 12-13s, about 4 sold a day. Buy 3 when passing through Auberdine on the way to Darnassus and post at 12-15s.
tests.result: Dropped before buying: listings went from 3 to 85 within a week and the lowest is 9.5s, about +4.8s each.
tests.lesson: A thin listing count on an unlimited vendor item does not last; other flippers find the same gap within days.

tests.name: Forceful armor kit patterns vendor flip
tests.plan: Pattern: Forceful Heavy Armor Kit (21s, Ironforge) and Pattern: Forceful Medium Armor Kit (5s, Bombus Finespindle, Ironforge). Post 2-3 at a time under the lowest listing.
tests.result: As of 2026-11-23: Heavy 10 bought for 2.00g, 10 sold for 4.27g (+2.27g), 3 expired. Medium 12 bought for 60s, 10 sold for 1.07g (+47s), 3 expired. +2.74g total. Today: Heavy 30s lowest with 12-21 listed (+7s each), Medium 10s with 80 listed (+4s).
tests.lesson: Heavy kit was the second-best flip this week. Keep Heavy going 2 at a time while the lowest stays above about 27s; pause Medium until listings drop.

tests.name: Pattern: Forceful Rugged Armor Kit from Aerie Peak
tests.plan: Nioma (Leatherworking Supplies, Aerie Peak, The Hinterlands, about 13.4, 43.4) sells it for about 50-55s, unlimited stock. US average 94s, usual price here 1.15g, lowest 1.2g with 32 listed, about 7.7 sold a day at 43%. Regis buys 3 on a trip to Aerie Peak (flight path) and posts 1-2 at a time near 1g: about +35s to +55s each.

tests.name: Pattern: Heavy Leather Ball (Ironforge limited stock)
tests.plan: Bombus Finespindle (Leatherworking Supplies, Ironforge, next to Granny Finespindle) stocks 1 at 20-21s. Lowest 40s with 16 listed, US average 38s, about 2 sold a day. Buy it whenever Bank Ey passes and post at 38-40s: about +15s each.

tests.name: Booty Bay vendor recipes
tests.plan: Next time Regis is in Booty Bay: Rikqiz (Leatherworking Supplies, about 28.2, 76.6) Pattern: Gem-studded Leather Belt, 30s, stock 1. US average 63s, usual 1.07g here, only 2 listed (at 5g), about 2 sold a day: post near 90s, expect +30s to +55s. Kelsey Yance (Cooking Supplies) Recipe: Giant Clam Scorcho, 50s, unlimited: lowest 70s with 15 listed, US 65s, 5.6 sold a day, expect about +12s; buy 2.

tests.name: Formula: Enchant Bracer - Lesser Strength (Astranaar limited stock)
tests.plan: Dalria (Trade Goods, Astranaar, Ashenvale) stocks 1 at 25s. Rejected last week with 71 listed; now 21 listed, US average 36s, usual 46s, 9.3 sold a day at 47%. Buy 1 when the Darnassus alt passes through Astranaar and post near 40s: about +10s to +15s.
